title: The golden lampstand and the two olive trees (fifth night vision)

symbols.in_text_interpretation: The seven are "the LORD's eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth" (4:10).

symbols.symbol: Two olive trees / two olive branches
symbols.in_text_interpretation: "The two anointed ones (sons of oil) who stand by the Lord of the whole earth" (4:14); not named.
Levelled before Zerubbabel, who will bring out the capstone (4:7).

description: A gold lampstand with a bowl and seven lamps, and two olive trees beside it; a word to Zerubbabel; the trees (and branches) explained as two anointed ones.
